content: The pinned EKS v21.26.0 module uses access entries, removes the aws-auth submodule, defaults add-ons to most_recent=true and resolve_conflicts_on_create=NONE, changes Karpenter to Pod Identity, and has breaking input renames documented in UPGRADE-21.0.md. Explicit addon_version values are required to satisfy this project’s version-pinned EKS-08 requirement.
